news.h: Raiders' Ashton Jeanty limited to 2 carries in win vs. Jets
news.d: Ashton Jeanty had a career low in carries Sunday, which coach Klint Kubiak said was his call but not a response to Jeanty's comments during the week.

news.h: Jets dealing with defensive injuries for matchup vs. Raiders, RB Ashton Jeanty
news.d: Jets nose tackle T'Vondre Sweat has been ruled out with a knee injury, and rookie edge rusher David Bailey, unable to practice this week due to a strained groin, is listed as doubtful.

news.h: What has gone wrong for 2025 running backs? Ashton Jeanty, Omarion Hampton, more
news.d: We thought last year's running back class was going to be great. But Ashton Jeanty, Omarion Hampton, TreVeyon Henderson and others haven't lived up to the hype.
